name: ballerina/observe
description: This module provides an API for observing Ballerina services.

typeDefs.name: Metric
typeDefs.description: This represents the generic metric record that can represent both counter and gauge.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: If the metric is configured with statistics config, then the calculated statistics of the metric

typeDefs.name: Snapshot
typeDefs.description: This represents the snapshot of the statistics calculation of the gauge.

fields.name: timeWindow
fields.description: The time window in which variation of the values are considered

fields.name: mean
fields.description: The average value within the time window

fields.name: max
fields.description: The max value within the time window

fields.name: min
fields.description: The min value within the time window

fields.name: stdDev
fields.description: The standard deviation value within the time window

fields.name: percentileValues
fields.description: The percentiles values calculated wihtin the time window

typeDefs.name: PercentileValue
typeDefs.description: This represents the percentile value record.

fields.name: percentile
fields.description: The percentile of the reported value

typeDefs.name: StatisticConfig
typeDefs.description: This represents the statistic configuration that can be used to instatiate gauge metric.

fields.name: percentiles
fields.description: The percentiles that needs to be calculated

fields.name: timeWindow
fields.description: The time window (in milli seconds) in which variation of the values are considered

fields.name: buckets
fields.description: The number of buckets used in the sliding time window

typeDefs.name: Counter
typeDefs.description:
This instantiates the Counter object. Name field is mandatory, and description and tags fields
are optional and have its own default values when no params are passed.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
This instantiates the Counter object. Name field is mandatory, and description and tags fields
are optional and have its own default values when no params are passed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the Counter instance

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description:
Description of the Counter instance. If no description is provided, the the default empty string
will be used

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: The key/value pair of Tags. If no tags are provided, the default nil value will be used

functions.name: register
functions.description: Register the counter metric instance with the Metric Registry.

return.description:
Returns error if there is any metric registered already with the same name
but different parameters or in a different kind

functions.name: unregister
functions.description: Unregister the counter metric instance with the Metric Registry.

functions.name: increment
functions.description: Increment the counter's value by an amount.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description:
The amount by which the value needs to be increased. The amount is defaulted as 1 and will be
used if there is no amount passed in

functions.name: reset
functions.description: Resets the counter's value to zero.

functions.name: getValue
functions.description: Retrieves the counter's current value.

return.description: The current value of the counter

typeDefs.name: Gauge
typeDefs.description:
This instantiates the Gauge object. Name field is mandatory, and description, tags, and statitics config fields
are optional and have its own default values when no params are passed.

functions.name: init
functions.description:
This instantiates the Gauge object. Name field is mandatory, and description, tags, and statitics config fields
are optional and have its own default values when no params are passed.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the Gauge instance

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description:
Description of the Gauge instance. If no description is provided, the the default empty string
will be used

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: The key/value pair of Tags. If no tags are provided, the default nil value will be used

parameters.name: statisticConfig
parameters.description:
Statistics configurations array is used for statistics calculation. In case if empty
statistics configurations array is passed, then statistics calculation will be disabled.
If nil () is passed, then default statistics configs will be used for the statitics
calculation

functions.name: register
functions.description: Register the gauge metric instance with the Metric Registry.

return.description:
Returns error if there is any metric registered already with the same name
but different parameters or in a different kind

functions.name: unregister
functions.description: Unregister the counter metric instance with the Metric Registry.

functions.name: increment
functions.description: Increment the gauge's value by an amount.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description:
The amount by which the value of gauge needs to be increased.
The amount is defaulted as 1.0 and will be used if there is no amount passed in

functions.name: decrement
functions.description: Decrement the gauge's value by an amount.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description:
The amount by which the value of gauge needs to be decreased.
The amount is defaulted as 1.0 and will be used if there is no amount passed in

functions.name: setValue
functions.description: Sets the instantaneous value for gauge.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The instantaneous value that needs to be set as gauge value

functions.name: getValue
functions.description: Retrieves the gauge's current value.

return.description: The current value of the gauge

functions.name: getSnapshot
functions.description: Retrieves statistics snapshots based on the statistics configs of the gauge.

return.description:
Array of the statistics snapshots.
If there is no statisticsConfigs provided, then it will be nil

functions.name: isObservabilityEnabled
functions.description: Check whether observability is enabled.

return.description: observability enabled/disabled.

functions.name: isMetricsEnabled
functions.description: Check whether metrics is enabled.

return.description: metrics enabled/disabled.

functions.name: isMetricsLogsEnabled
functions.description: Check whether metrics logs is enabled.

return.description: metrics enabled/disabled.

functions.name: getMetricsProvider
functions.description: Retrieve metrics provider.

return.description: metrics provider.

functions.name: getMetricsReporter
functions.description: Retrieve metrics reporter.

return.description: metrics reporter.

functions.name: isTracingEnabled
functions.description: Check whether tracing is enabled.

return.description: tracing enabled/disabled.

functions.name: getTracingProvider
functions.description: Retrieve tracer provider.

return.description: Tracing provider.

functions.name: startRootSpan
functions.description: Start a span with no parent span.

parameters.name: spanName
parameters.description: Name of the span

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to be associated to the span

return.description: SpanId of the started span

functions.name: startSpan
functions.description: Start a span and create child relationship to current active span or user specified span.

parameters.name: spanName
parameters.description: Name of the span

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tags to be associated to the span

parameters.name: parentSpanId
parameters.description: Id of the parent span or -1 if parent span should be taken from system trace

return.description: SpanId of the started span

functions.name: addTag
functions.description: Add a key-value pair as a tag to the root.

parameters.name: tagKey
parameters.description: Key of the tag

parameters.name: tagValue
parameters.description: Value of the tag

return.description: An error if adding the tag failed; otherwise null

functions.name: getTagValue
functions.description: Get the value of a given key of a tag.

parameters.name: tagKey
parameters.description: Key of the tag

return.description: The value of the tag if present; otherwise null

functions.name: addTagToSpan
functions.description: Add a key value pair as a tag to the span.

parameters.name: tagKey
parameters.description: Key of the tag

parameters.name: tagValue
parameters.description: Value of the tag

parameters.name: spanId
parameters.description: Id of span to which the tags should be added or -1 to add tags to the current active span

return.description: An error if an error occurred while attaching tag to the span

functions.name: addTagToMetrics
functions.description: Add a key value pair as a tag to system metrics.

parameters.name: tagKey
parameters.description: Key of the tag

parameters.name: tagValue
parameters.description: Value of the tag

return.description: An error if an error occurred while attaching tag to System Metrics

functions.name: finishSpan
functions.description: Finish the current span.

parameters.name: spanId
parameters.description: Id of span to finish

return.description: An error if an error occurred while finishing the span

functions.name: finishSpanWithError
functions.description: Finish the current span.

parameters.name: spanId
parameters.description: Id of span to finish

parameters.name: 'error
parameters.description: Error to be recorded in the span

return.description: An error if an error occurred while finishing the span

functions.name: getSpanContext
functions.description: Retrieve a map of span context data.

return.description: Map of span context data (traceId and spanId).

functions.name: getAllMetrics
functions.description: Retrieve all registered metrics including default metrics from the ballerina runtime, and user defined metrics.

return.description: Array of all registered metrics

functions.name: lookupMetric
functions.description: Retrieve the specific metric that is described by the given name and tags.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the metric to lookup

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: The key/value pair tags associated with the metric that should be looked up

return.description: The metric instance

annotations.name: Observable
annotations.description:
This is used for making a function observable.
Can be applied to functions which are not observable by default to make them observable.
